footer: akinayhan.com isn't ready yet… but the mind is already running.

general: This site isn't empty, it's just not in a hurry.
The code has started moving… Things are getting complicated in the background :) We'll be live very soon.
We're trying new things… Sometimes we break them, sometimes we make them better.
Loops never end, but every step teaches something…
An if condition can be as important as a life decision.
Everything made sense… until we ran it.
Thoughts deepen just like lines of code… and sometimes they throw errors.
Algorithms quietly shape the world; few people notice.
Comments are notes your past self leaves for your future self.
If it works, don't touch it… but don't forget to understand why it works.
Some bugs aren't in the code, but in the perspective.
When the code goes silent, the errors start talking.
Mastery isn't knowing how to write code, but knowing what not to write.
Some solutions are fast, some are right… rarely are they both.
Every 'temporary solution' is a candidate for becoming permanent.
Between 0 and 1 there is not only data, but decisions.
Every system carries its own chaos within.
What you think is control is often just a well-hidden coincidence.
Reality could be a well-written simulation.
Every loop searches for an exit.
Everything looks deterministic… if you don't look closely enough.
night: Some things are only understood at night.
When the lights go out, systems start talking.
day: Even when everything is bright, some things remain hidden.
Code that runs during the day is questioned at night.

quotes: I don't know if the time is right… but you arrived.
Maybe it's not about time, but the moment you notice.
You didn't plan to come here… but you did.
If you think you're late, perhaps you arrived early.
Some moments aren't chosen… you simply fall into them.
I don't know if you're the right person… but the timing is suspicious.
Who even checks whether the timing is right?
This moment has no name… but you're in it.
Your being here doesn't look like a small coincidence.
Time keeps flowing… but some moments stay still.
Maybe there was never such a thing as the right time.
